entries.acceptance: At 1280 px, mid-run, the progress component sits at the top of the results area and spans its width. It reads as the Bulk Sim dialog laid out for the tab: a title over a divider; on the left, the phase name over a bar that spans the column, with the done/total count under it; on the right, Elapsed Time, rows landed and time remaining, and a Stop button with the Bulk dialog's cancel styling. Before the first sim count the bar shows moving stripes, not a filled bar. From the first count it is the Bulk dialog's green bar at the done/total width. Two differences from the Bulk dialog are deliberate: the count under the bar is a lighter grey, for contrast, and the title is left-aligned, for the wide layout. The phase names follow the run (preparing, Simming candidates, Measuring set bonuses, Re-simming the top rows). Rows appear in the table under the component as they finish, with no empty status row above the component. The component covers and dims nothing. Fact `panelFits375` is true: at 375 px the progress component itself fits the viewport width.
